action.instructions: buy on strength only when the book can absorb it

criteria.buy: the move is strong and depth is not thin
criteria.sell: the move is fading or fees are climbing

skip_this_cycle.instructions: conditions are too hostile to trade at all

behavioral_assumptions.note: Assumptions for sanity scoring (not labelled ground truth from article). Article only shows one example state→hold.
behavioral_assumptions.bullish_lean_buy: deep + quiet fees + pumping + calm + early + green → expect buy mass or at least buy>sell
behavioral_assumptions.bearish_lean_sell: thin + bot_war + fading/dumping + violent + late + red → expect sell mass or sell>buy
behavioral_assumptions.hostile_lean_skip_or_hold: thin + bot_war + violent (hostile book) → higher skip noul and/or hold
behavioral_assumptions.article_state: match article example: hold peaked (~0.81), skip modest (~0.22)
